text_en: The allotment of the Josephites went from the Jordan by Jericho, east of the waters of Jericho, into the wilderness, going up from Jericho into the hill country to Bethel;
text_cn: 若瑟的子孙抽签分得的土地，从耶里哥对面的约但河起，到耶里哥东面的水源，沿着旷野，由耶里哥向上到贝特耳山区，

text_en: then going from Bethel to Luz, it passes along to Ataroth, the territory of the Archites;
text_cn: 再由贝特耳路次，沿着阿尔基人的边境，延至阿塔洛特。

text_en: then it goes down westward to the territory of the Japhletites, as far as the territory of Lower Beth-horon, then to Gezer, and it ends at the sea.
text_cn: 然后向西下至雅费肋提人的境界，直到下贝特曷龙的边境，以迄于革则尔，直达于海。

text_en: The Josephites—Manasseh and Ephraim—received their inheritance.
text_cn: 这是若瑟的儿子默纳协和厄弗辣因分得的产业。

text_en: The territory of the Ephraimites by their families was as follows: the boundary of their inheritance on the east was Ataroth-addar as far as Upper Beth-horon,
text_cn: 以下是厄弗辣因子孙按照家族分得的土地：他们产业的边界，东面是阿塔洛特阿达尔，直到上贝特曷龙，

text_en: and the boundary goes from there to the sea; on the north is Michmethath; then on the east the boundary makes a turn toward Taanath-shiloh, and passes along beyond it on the east to Janoah,
text_cn: 直达于海。北端是米革默塔特，由此向东转向塔纳特史罗，越过雅诺亚东部，

text_en: then it goes down from Janoah to Ataroth and to Naarah, and touches Jericho, ending at the Jordan.
text_cn: 再由雅诺亚下至阿塔洛特和纳阿辣，经耶里哥直达约但河。

text_en: From Tappuah the boundary goes westward to the Wadi Kanah, and ends at the sea. Such is the inheritance of the tribe of the Ephraimites by their families,
text_cn: 又从塔普亚往西到卡纳谷，直达于海：以上是厄弗辣因子孙按照家族分得的产业。

text_en: together with the towns that were set apart for the Ephraimites within the inheritance of the Manassites, all those towns with their villages.
text_cn: 此外，属默纳协子孙的产业中，还有给厄弗辣因子孙保留的城市，──城市和所属的村镇。

text_en: They did not, however, drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer: so the Canaanites have lived within Ephraim to this day but have been made to do forced labor.
text_cn: 但是他们未能将住在革则尔的客纳罕人赶走，因此客纳罕人直到今日还住在厄弗辣因人中间，充当苦役。
